title: ViCARD: Visual Credit Assignment with Reward-Gated Distillation for Multimodal Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.33437v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Visual reasoning requires models to identify relevant visual evidence and use it to derive correct answers. Outcomebased reinforcement learning (RL) faces two key challenges in this regime: it yields no learning signal when perceptual errors cause all sampled responses to fail, and it broadcasts a uniform advantage across every token within a response. Conversely, while visual self-distillation offers dense guidance from evidence-centered image crops, student learning from token distributions alone often fails to elicit correct final answers. Motivated by an audit of training rollouts that exposes these complementary failure modes, we introduce ViCARD (Visual Credit Assignment with RewardGated Distillation), which integrates per-token visual supervision with verified correctness rewards. For each rollout group, we leverage a teacher with its input image cropped to the relevant visual area, and use this to provide per-token supervision

translated_title: ViCARD：面向多模态推理的基于奖励门控蒸馏的视觉信用分配方法
translated_abstract: 视觉推理要求模型能够识别相关的视觉证据，并利用这些证据推导出正确的答案。基于结果的强化学习（RL）在这一场景中面临两个关键挑战：当感知错误导致所有采样响应均失败时，它无法产生任何学习信号；同时它会在响应内的每个token上广播统一的advantage（优势值）。相反，虽然视觉自蒸馏能够通过以证据为中心的图像裁剪提供密集的指导，但仅从token分布中学习的学生模型往往无法得出正确的最终答案。基于对训练rollout的审计所揭示的这些互补性失败模式，我们提出了ViCARD（带奖励门控蒸馏的视觉信用分配），它将逐token的视觉监督与经过验证的正确性奖励相结合。对于每个rollout组，我们利用一个输入图像被裁剪至相关视觉区域的教师模型，并使用它来提供逐token的监督。
tldr: ViCARD通过奖励门控蒸馏，将逐token的视觉监督与经过验证的正确性奖励相结合，同时解决了基于结果的强化学习和视觉自蒸馏在多模态推理中的互补性失败模式。
en_tdlr: ViCARD integrates per-token visual supervision with verified correctness rewards via reward-gated distillation, addressing the complementary failure modes of outcome-based reinforcement learning and visual self-distillation in multimodal reasoning.
